text: Hilary Brown, ICES Adjunct Scientist, Yona Lunsky, ICES Adjunct Scientist, and Lesley Plumptre, ICES Staff Scientist will give a presentation on Ontario Disability Related Data and COVID-19. This presentation will cover previous and ongoing COVID-19 related work in people with disabilities. COVID-19 related outcomes and vaccination coverage in disability populations will be shared along with where to find additional resources for further information.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. City Council forward the presentation from the ICES Scientists to the Board of Health and Toronto Public Health with the request that they be invited to present the information at an upcoming meeting.
